cmd: xtcp2-nl-ipmon c0 "monitor address maddress" "ip -6 addr add 2001:db8:1::1/64 dev r0" "2001:db8:1::1/64" "dadfailed"
desc: positive: the dadfailed corner, a duplicate on the peer and one DAD probe
pre: n=$(ip netns identify $$) && ip netns set "$n" 0 && ip link add c0 type dummy && ip link set c0 up && ip link add r0 type veth peer name r0p && ip link set r0 up && ip link set r0p up && sysctl -wq net.ipv6.conf.r0.dad_transmits=1 && ip -6 addr add 2001:db8:1::1/64 dev r0p nodad
